description: The objective of this course is to develop the learning capabilities and hone the problem solving skills of talented students at a mathematically deeper and more rigorous level. The contents of this course will consist of those in the regular course (MA2202 Algebra I) and the following additional topics: Group action, group representations, profinite groups and classical groups.
